items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Well, he worked with me in Buffalo, but he's on his own now.

ctx.x: The guy that's playing now that's doing such a terrific job now that's just now got a good break. What's his name? Making all these fine records. Oh, my goodness. I can't call his name as well as I know him. Well, he worked with me in Buffalo, but he's on his own now. Is he Roy Eldridge? No, Roy. This is one of the old timers that's playing this good, good...
